cases.sentence: В их родословии значатся главы семейств и двадцать тысяч двести ___.
cases.explain: «храбрых воинов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

cases.sentence: ___, готовых идти на войну, было семнадцать тысяч двести человек.
cases.explain: «Храбрых воинов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

cases.sentence: Их земли и поселения включали Вефиль с ___, Нааран на востоке, Гезер с окрестными поселениями на западе и Шехем с окрестными поселениями до самого Гая и окрестных поселений.
cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «до», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

cases.sentence: На границах земель манасситов находились Бет-Шеан, Таанах, Мегиддо и Дор с их ___.
cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

cases.sentence: Все они были потомками Асира — главы кланов, избранные, ___, великие вожди.
cases.explain: «храбрые воины» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

cases.translation: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
